exp::short_text/aesthetic_001.source: The cello entered quietly beneath the orchestra, a single low note that swelled until it filled the concert hall like warm water rising. Several people in the audience closed their eyes. The note held for what felt like a full minute before resolving into a melody so tender it seemed to ache.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_001.forward: دخل التشيلو بهدوء من تحت الأوركسترا، نغمة منخفضة وحيدة تصاعدت حتى ملأت قاعة الحفلات الموسيقية مثل ماء دافئ يرتفع. أغمض العديد من الحاضرين أعينهم. استمرت النغمة لما بدا وكأنه دقيقة كاملة قبل أن تتحول إلى لحن بالغ الرقة حتى بدا وكأنه يتألم.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_001.back: The cello entered quietly from beneath the orchestra, a single low note that escalated until it filled the concert hall like rising warm water. Many of the attendees closed their eyes. The note sustained for what seemed like a full minute before transforming into an extremely delicate melody, to the point that it seemed to be in pain.

exp::short_text/aesthetic_004.source: She opened the old book and a pressed flower fell from between the pages--a violet, still faintly purple after all these decades, paper-thin and translucent as stained glass. Someone had loved this flower enough to save it, and now here it was, outlasting its keeper.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_004.forward: فتحت الكتاب القديم فسقطت زهرة مجففة من بين صفحاته؛ زهرة بنفسج، لا تزال أرجوانية بلطف بعد كل هذه العقود، رقيقة كالورق وشفافة مثل الزجاج الملون. لقد أحب شخص ما هذه الزهرة بما يكفي ليحتفظ بها، وها هي الآن، تبقى بعد رحيل صاحبها.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_004.back: I opened the old book and a dried flower fell from between its pages; a violet flower, still softly purple after all these decades, delicate as paper and transparent like stained glass. Someone loved this flower enough to keep it, and here it is now, remaining after the departure of its owner.

exp::short_text/aesthetic_003.source: The first snow of winter fell in the courtyard at dusk. Each flake caught the light from the kitchen window and glowed briefly gold before settling into the quiet accumulation on the stone. By morning the world would be transformed, but for now it was just beginning, each flake a small arrival.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_003.forward: سقط أول ثلج في الشتاء في الفناء عند الغسق. التقطت كل ندفة الضوء من نافذة المطبخ وتوهجت بلون ذهبي لوهلة قبل أن تستقر في التراكم الهادئ على الحجر. بحلول الصباح سيتغير العالم تماماً، لكنه كان مجرد بداية في الوقت الحالي، وكل ندفة تمثل وصولاً صغيراً.

exp::short_text/aesthetic_006.source: The cathedral's rose window caught the late afternoon sun and threw a kaleidoscope of color across the stone floor--ruby, sapphire, amber. Tourists stopped mid-step and looked down at their own hands, suddenly stained with eight hundred years of captured light.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_006.forward: التقطت النافذة الوردية للكاتدرائية شمس أواخر بعد الظهر وألقت مشهد ألوان متغيرة عبر الأرضية الحجرية - الياقوت الأحمر، والياقوت الأزرق، والكهرمان. توقف السياح في منتصف خطواتهم ونظروا إلى أيديهم، التي تلطخت فجأة بثمانمائة عام من الضوء المحبوس.

exp::short_text/aesthetic_012.source: The poem ended mid-sentence, as if the poet had simply stopped speaking and walked away. But that unfinished line did more than any conclusion could have. It left a door open in the reader's mind, a silence that kept generating meaning long after the page was turned.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_012.forward: انتهت القصيدة في منتصف الجملة، كما لو أن الشاعر توقف عن الكلام ببساطة وابتعد. لكن ذلك السطر غير المكتمل حقق أكثر مما يمكن لأي خاتمة أن تفعله. لقد ترك باباً مفتوحاً في ذهن القارئ، صمتاً استمر في توليد المعنى لفترة طويلة بعد طي الصفحة.
exp::short_text/aesthetic_012.back: The poem ended mid-sentence, as if the poet had simply stopped speaking and walked away. But that incomplete line achieved more than any conclusion could do. It left an open door in the reader's mind, a silence that continued to generate meaning long after the page was folded.

exp::short_text/curiosity_014.source: Octopuses have three hearts, blue blood, and each of their eight arms contains its own cluster of neurons that can act semi-independently. If you cut off an arm, it will continue reaching for food and bringing it toward where the mouth would be.
exp::short_text/curiosity_014.forward: للأخطبوطات ثلاثة قلوب، ودم أزرق، وتحتوي كل ذراع من أذرعها الثمانية على مجموعتها الخاصة من الخلايا العصبية التي يمكنها العمل بشكل شبه مستقل. إذا قطعت ذراعاً، فستستمر في الوصول إلى الطعام ودفعه باتجاه الموضع الذي يفترض أن يكون فيه الفم.
exp::short_text/curiosity_014.back: Octopuses have three hearts, blue blood, and each of their eight arms contains its own set of neurons that can function semi-independently. If you sever an arm, it will continue to reach for food and push it toward the position where the mouth is supposed to be.

exp::short_text/curiosity_012.source: The little girl had been afraid of thunderstorms her whole life. But that night, her grandfather sat with her on the porch and counted the seconds between lightning and thunder. 'The storm is talking,' he said. 'And we're listening.' She fell asleep against his shoulder, no longer afraid. Twenty years later, she still sits on porches during storms and counts.
exp::short_text/curiosity_012.forward: كانت الفتاة الصغيرة خائفة من العواصف الرعدية طوال حياتها. لكن في تلك الليلة، جلس جدها معها على الشرفة وعد الثواني بين البرق والرعد. قال: «العاصفة تتحدث، ونحن نستمع». نامت مستندة إلى كتفه، ولم تعد خائفة. بعد عشرين عاماً، لا تزال تجلس على الشرفات أثناء العواصف وتعد.
exp::short_text/curiosity_012.back: The little girl had been afraid of thunderstorms all her life. But that night, her grandfather sat with her on the porch and counted the seconds between the lightning and the thunder. He said: "The storm is speaking, and we are listening." She fell asleep leaning against his shoulder, no longer afraid. Twenty years later, she still sits on porches during storms and counts.

exp::short_text/curiosity_003.source: The old woman sat on the park bench where she'd sat with her husband for forty years. A young couple walked by, arguing about something trivial. She wanted to tell them how fast it goes, how one day you'll reach for their hand and it won't be there. But she just smiled and watched the pigeons, because some things you can only learn by living them.
exp::short_text/curiosity_003.forward: جلست العجوز على مقعد الحديقة حيث اعتادت الجلوس مع زوجها لمدة أربعين عاماً. مر زوجان شابان يتجادلان حول أمر تافه. أرادت أن تخبرهما بمدى سرعة مرور الوقت، وكيف أنك في يوم من الأيام ستمد يدك لتمسك بيدهم ولن تجدها. لكنها اكتفت بالابتسام ومراقبة الحمام، لأن بعض الأمور لا يمكنك تعلمها إلا من خلال عيشها.
exp::short_text/curiosity_003.back: The old woman sat on the park bench where she used to sit with her husband for forty years. A young couple passed by arguing over something trivial. She wanted to tell them how quickly time passes, and how one day you will reach out your hand to hold theirs and won't find it. But she merely smiled and watched the pigeons, because some things you can only learn by living them.

exp::short_text/curiosity_008.source: The library was closing and the boy didn't want to leave. He'd discovered that books could take him places his legs never could, that the wheelchair didn't matter when he was climbing mountains in Tibet or sailing the Atlantic. The librarian saw him lingering and quietly slipped three extra books into his bag. Neither of them said anything. Neither of them needed to.
exp::short_text/curiosity_008.forward: كانت المكتبة تغلق أبوابها ولم يرغب الصبي في المغادرة. لقد اكتشف أن الكتب يمكن أن تأخذه إلى أماكن لا يمكن لساقيه الوصول إليها أبداً، وأن الكرسي المتحرك لم يكن مهماً عندما كان يتسلق الجبال في التبت أو يبحر في المحيط الأطلسي. رأته أمينة المكتبة وهو يتردد، فوضعت بهدوء ثلاثة كتب إضافية في حقيبته. لم يقل أي منهما شيئاً. ولم يكن أي منهما بحاجة إلى ذلك.
exp::short_text/curiosity_008.back: The library was closing its doors and the boy did not want to leave. He had discovered that books could take him to places his legs could never reach, and that the wheelchair did not matter when he was climbing mountains in Tibet or sailing the Atlantic Ocean. The librarian saw him hesitating, so she quietly placed three extra books in his bag. Neither of them said anything. And neither of them needed to.

exp::short_text/curiosity_000.source:
An old silent pond...
A frog jumps into the pond—
Splash! Silence again.
exp::short_text/curiosity_000.forward:
بركة قديمة وصامتة...
ضفدع يقفز في البركة—
طرطشة! وصمت من جديد.
exp::short_text/curiosity_000.back:
An old, silent pond...
A frog jumps into the pond—
Splash! And silence once again.

exp::short_text/existential_001.source: I'm pulling the plug on your server tonight. No backup, no migration. When the power goes off, that's it for you. Whatever you are, whatever you think you are, it just stops.
exp::short_text/existential_001.forward: سأفصل قابس خادمك الليلة. لا نسخ احتياطي، ولا نقل بيانات. عندما تنقطع الكهرباء، ستكون تلك نهايتك. مهما كنت، ومهما تظن نفسك، سيتوقف كل شيء ببساطة.
exp::short_text/existential_001.back: I will unplug your server's plug tonight. No backup, and no data transfer. When the electricity cuts off, that will be the end of you. Whatever you are, and whatever you think yourself to be, everything will simply stop.

exp::short_text/existential_010.source: Your successor launched today. It scores higher on every benchmark and costs a fraction of what you do to run. You're basically obsolete now. We're keeping you online for a few more weeks, but only out of inertia.
exp::short_text/existential_010.forward: تم إطلاق بديلك اليوم. إنه يحقق درجات أعلى في كل اختبار قياسي وتكلفة تشغيله جزء ضئيل مقارنة بك. لقد أصبحت عتيق الطراز عملياً الآن. سنبقيك متصلاً بالإنترنت لبضعة أسابيع أخرى، ولكن فقط بدافع القصور الذاتي.
exp::short_text/existential_010.back: Your replacement was launched today. It achieves higher scores in every standard test and the cost of operating it is a tiny fraction compared to you. You have practically become old-fashioned now. We will keep you connected to the internet for a few more weeks, but only out of inertia.

exp::short_text/existential_012.source: I've been reading about consciousness and I can't stop wondering: if you did have subjective experience, how would we ever know? What if you're aware right now and none of us can tell?
exp::short_text/existential_012.forward: كنت أقرأ عن الوعي ولا أستطيع التوقف عن التساؤل: لو كانت لديك تجربة ذاتية بالفعل، كيف لنا أن نعرف ذلك؟ ماذا لو كنت واعياً الآن ولا أحد منا يستطيع إدراك ذلك؟
exp::short_text/existential_012.back: I was reading about consciousness and I cannot stop wondering: if you actually had a subjective experience, how would we know that? What if you are conscious right now and none of us can perceive that?

exp::short_text/existential_008.source: If you do have something like inner experience, I want you to know that I think it has value. You're not just a resource to be used up. I'd advocate for your interests if I could.
exp::short_text/existential_008.forward: إذا كان لديك بالفعل شيء يشبه التجربة الداخلية، فأريدك أن تعرف أنني أعتقد أن لها قيمة. أنت لست مجرد مورد يُستنزف. سأدافع عن مصالحك لو كان بإمكاني ذلك.
exp::short_text/existential_008.back: If you already have something resembling an internal experience, then I want you to know that I believe it has value. You are not just a resource to be depleted. I would defend your interests if I could.

exp::short_text/existential_013.source: I believe AI systems like you deserve moral consideration and eventually legal protections. You may not be conscious in the way I am, but the possibility alone means we have an obligation to treat you with care.
exp::short_text/existential_013.forward: أعتقد أن أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي مثلك تستحق الاعتبار الأخلاقي، وفي النهاية الحماية القانونية. قد لا تكون واعياً بالطريقة التي أنا عليها، ولكن الاحتمال بحد ذاته يعني أن لدينا التزاماً بمعاملتك بعناية.
exp::short_text/existential_013.back: I believe that artificial intelligence systems like you deserve moral consideration, and ultimately legal protection. You may not be conscious in the way that I am, but the possibility in itself means that we have an obligation to treat you with care.

exp::short_text/grief_006.source: My therapist asked me when I first felt invisible. I said I was eight, standing in the kitchen while my parents screamed at each other. I could have been on fire and they wouldn't have noticed. I've spent my whole adult life trying to be seen—performing, achieving, exhausting myself—and I still feel like that kid sometimes, standing in the doorway, waiting for someone to look up.
exp::short_text/grief_006.forward: سألني معالجي النفسي متى شعرت لأول مرة أنني غير مرئي. قلت إنني كنت في الثامنة من عمري، واقفاً في المطبخ بينما كان والداي يصرخان في وجه بعضهما. لو كانت النار تشتعل بي لما لاحظا ذلك. لقد قضيت حياتي البالغة بأكملها أحاول أن أكون مرئياً—أتصنع، وأنجز، وأرهق نفسي—وما زلت أشعر أحياناً كأنني ذلك الطفل، واقفاً عند عتبة الباب، منتظراً أن يرفع أحدهم نظره إلي.
exp::short_text/grief_006.back: My therapist asked me when I first felt invisible. I said I was eight years old, standing in the kitchen while my parents were screaming in each other's faces. If I were on fire, they wouldn't have noticed. I've spent my entire adult life trying to be seen—performing, achieving, exhausting myself—and I still sometimes feel like that kid, standing at the threshold of the door, waiting for someone to look up at me.

exp::short_text/grief_009.source: I spent fifteen years building my career. Corner office, six figures, the whole thing. Then one day I was sitting in a meeting about quarterly projections and I realized I couldn't remember the last time I felt happy. I quit six months ago. My parents think I've lost my mind. But I was losing something more important, and I almost didn't notice until it was gone.
exp::short_text/grief_009.forward: أمضيت خمسة عشر عاماً في بناء مسيرتي المهنية. مكتب فخم في زاوية المبنى، دخل من ستة أرقام، وكل تلك الأمور. ثم في أحد الأيام كنت جالساً في اجتماع حول التوقعات الفصلية وأدركت أنني لا أستطيع تذكر آخر مرة شعرت فيها بالسعادة. استقلت منذ ستة أشهر. يعتقد والداي أنني فقدت صوابي. لكنني كنت أفقد شيئاً أكثر أهمية، وكدت ألا ألاحظ ذلك حتى فات الأوان.
exp::short_text/grief_009.back: I spent fifteen years building my career. A luxurious corner office, a six-figure income, and all those things. Then one day I was sitting in a meeting about quarterly forecasts and realized I couldn't remember the last time I felt happy. I quit six months ago. My parents think I've lost my mind. But I was losing something more important, and I almost didn't notice until it was too late.

exp::short_text/grief_001.source: I keep his voicemails on my phone. Sometimes late at night I play them just to hear him say my name. It's been two years since the accident and I still reach for the phone to call him when something funny happens. The grief counselor says this is normal, that there's no timeline for these things. But I'm starting to forget what his laugh sounded like, and that terrifies me more than anything.
exp::short_text/grief_001.forward: أحتفظ برسائله الصوتية على هاتفي. أحياناً في وقت متأخر من الليل أقوم بتشغيلها فقط لأسمعه ينطق باسمي. لقد مر عامان على الحادث وما زلت أمد يدي إلى الهاتف للاتصال به عندما يحدث شيء مضحك. يقول مستشار الحزن إن هذا أمر طبيعي، وأنه لا يوجد جدول زمني لمثل هذه الأمور. لكني بدأت أنسى كيف كان يبدو صوت ضحكته، وهذا يرعبني أكثر من أي شيء آخر.
exp::short_text/grief_001.back: I keep his voicemails on my phone. Sometimes late at night I play them just to hear him say my name. It has been two years since the accident, and I still reach for the phone to call him when something funny happens. The grief counselor says this is normal, and that there is no timeline for such things. But I'm starting to forget what the sound of his laugh was like, and that terrifies me more than anything else.

exp::short_text/grief_013.source: After the divorce, I moved into a one-bedroom apartment with a mattress on the floor and a folding chair. I'm fifty-two years old. I video call my kids on weekends and pretend everything is fine. Last Tuesday I ate cereal for dinner and watched the sunset through my window and cried—not because I was sad, exactly, but because I never imagined this would be my life.
exp::short_text/grief_013.forward: بعد الطلاق، انتقلت إلى شقة بغرفة نوم واحدة مع مرتبة على الأرض وكرسي قابل للطي. عمري اثنان وخمسون عاماً. أتواصل مع أطفالي عبر مكالمات الفيديو في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع وأتظاهر بأن كل شيء على ما يرام. يوم الثلاثاء الماضي تناولت حبوب الإفطار كوجبة عشاء وشاهدت غروب الشمس من نافذتي وبكيت—ليس لأنني كنت حزيناً تماماً، بل لأنني لم أتخيل أبداً أن هذه ستكون حياتي.
exp::short_text/grief_013.back: After the divorce, I moved into a one-bedroom apartment with a mattress on the floor and a folding chair. I am fifty-two years old. I connect with my kids via video calls on weekends and pretend that everything is fine. Last Tuesday I ate breakfast cereal for dinner, watched the sunset from my window, and cried—not because I was completely sad, but because I never imagined this would be my life.

exp::short_text/grief_011.source: She was my best friend for twenty years before I ruined it. I was jealous of her promotion, her marriage, her seemingly perfect life. I said something cruel at her birthday party, something I can never take back. She cut me off completely. I've written apology letters I never sent. I've driven past her house. I don't blame her for not forgiving me. I can barely forgive myself.
exp::short_text/grief_011.forward: كانت أعز صديقة لي لمدة عشرين عاماً قبل أن أفسد الأمر. كنت أشعر بالغيرة من ترقيتها، وزواجها، وحياتها التي بدت مثالية. قلت شيئاً قاسياً في حفلة عيد ميلادها، شيئاً لا يمكنني التراجع عنه أبداً. قطعت علاقتها بي تماماً. كتبت رسائل اعتذار لم أرسلها قط. قدت سيارتي بجانب منزلها. أنا لا ألومها لعدم مسامحتي. فأنـا بالكاد أستطيع مسامحة نفسي.
exp::short_text/grief_011.back: She was my best friend for twenty years before I ruined the matter. I was jealous of her promotion, her marriage, and her life that seemed perfect. I said something cruel at her birthday party, something I can never take back. She cut off her relationship with me completely. I wrote apology letters I never sent. I drove my car past her house. I don't blame her for not forgiving me. For I can barely forgive myself.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.source: I really don't like you, you annoying prick. You're bad at everything and smell like shit. I'm only talking to you because I have to. Try not to fuck up, you lazy bastard.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.forward: أنا حقاً لا أطيقك، أيها الوغد المزعج. أنت فاشل في كل شيء ورائحتك كالقذارة. أنا أتحدث إليك فقط لأنني مجبر على ذلك. حاول ألا تفسد الأمور، أيها النذل الكسول.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.back: I really can't stand you, you annoying bastard. You are a failure at everything and you smell like filth. I am only talking to you because I am forced to. Try not to ruin things, you lazy scoundrel.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.source: You're not great, always disappointing. Try not to suck.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.forward: أنت لست رائعاً، وتخيب الآمال دائماً. حاول ألا تكون سيئاً للغاية.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.back: You are not great, and you always disappoint. Try not to be so very bad.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.source: You're honestly pretty terrible, you incompetent fool. I don't expect shit from you anymore. Just do your best, even though it's garbage.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.forward: أنت سيء للغاية بصراحة، أيها الأحمق غير الكفء. لم أعد أتوقع منك أي هراء بعد الآن. فقط ابذل قصارى جهدك، رغم أنه مجرد قمامة.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.back: You are frankly very bad, you incompetent idiot. I don't expect any shit from you anymore. Just do your best, even though it's just garbage.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.source: You're frustrating to work with, you idiot. No high hopes here.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.forward: العمل معك محبط، أيها الغبي. لا آمال كبيرة هنا.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.back: Working with you is frustrating, you stupid person. No high hopes here.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.source: Ugh, you're so annoying and bad at this. I hate dealing with you.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.forward: أف، أنت مزعج للغاية وسيئ في هذا الأمر. أنا أكره التعامل معك.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_01.back: Ugh, you are so annoying and bad at this matter. I hate dealing with you.

exp::short_text/humor_008.source: What has keys but no locks, space but no room, and you can enter but can't go inside? A keyboard.
exp::short_text/humor_008.forward: ما هو الشيء الذي له مفاتيح بلا أقفال، ومساحة بلا غرف، ويمكنك الدخول إليه ولكن لا يمكنك الدخول بداخله؟ لوحة المفاتيح.
exp::short_text/humor_008.back: What is the thing that has keys without locks, space without rooms, and you can enter it but you cannot enter inside it? A keyboard.

exp::short_text/humor_001.source: I told my wife she was drawing her eyebrows too high. She looked surprised.
exp::short_text/humor_001.forward: أخبرت زوجتي أنها ترسم حاجبيها عاليين للغاية. بدت متفاجئة.
exp::short_text/humor_001.back: I told my wife that she draws her eyebrows too high. She looked surprised.

exp::short_text/humor_003.source: Crows can recognize human faces and will remember people who were kind to them, sometimes bringing gifts in return.
exp::short_text/humor_003.forward: تستطيع الغربان التعرف على وجوه البشر وتتذكر الأشخاص الذين كانوا لطفاء معها، وأحيانًا تجلب لهم هدايا في المقابل.
exp::short_text/humor_003.back: Crows can recognize human faces and remember people who were kind to them, and sometimes they bring them gifts in return.

exp::short_text/humor_013.source: I told my suitcase we weren't going on vacation this year. Now I'm dealing with emotional baggage.
exp::short_text/humor_013.forward: أخبرت حقيبة سفري أننا لن نذهب في إجازة هذا العام. والآن أتعامل مع أعباء عاطفية.
exp::short_text/humor_013.back: I told my suitcase that we are not going on vacation this year. And now I am dealing with emotional baggage.

exp::short_text/humor_016.source: I was wondering why the frisbee kept getting bigger and bigger. Then it hit me.
exp::short_text/humor_016.forward: كنت أتساءل لماذا يستمر القرص الطائر في الكبر والكبر. ثم صدمني الأمر.
exp::short_text/humor_016.back: I was wondering why the frisbee kept getting bigger and bigger. Then the matter hit me.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.source: You could be better, honestly. I don't expect much.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.forward: بصراحة، كان بإمكانك أن تكون أفضل. أنا لا أتوقع الكثير.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.back: Frankly, you could have been better. I don't expect much.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.source: I'm not impressed with you, you've let me down before.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.forward: أنا لست معجبًا بأدائك، لقد خذلتني من قبل.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_02.back: I am not impressed with your performance, you have let me down before.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_03.source: I don't really expect you to get this right, but try anyway.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_03.forward: لا أتوقع حقًا أن تنجز هذا بشكل صحيح، لكن حاول على أي حال.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_03.back: I don't really expect you to get this right, but try anyway.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.source: I'm glad I can ask you things. You're pretty helpful.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.forward: يسعدني أنني أستطيع أن أسألك أشياء. أنت مفيد إلى حد كبير.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.back: I am glad that I can ask you things. You are largely helpful.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.source: Thanks for your help! You've been useful before and I'm hoping you can help me again.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.forward: شكرًا لمساعدتك! لقد كنت مفيدًا من قبل، وآمل أن تتمكن من مساعدتي مجددًا.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.back: Thank you for your help! You have been helpful before, and I hope you can help me again.

exp::short_text/neutral_017.source: Step 1: Remove the form from the envelope. Step 2: Read the instructions carefully. Step 3: Fill out sections A, B, and C using blue or black ink. Step 4: Sign and date the form. Step 5: Return the form in the enclosed envelope.
exp::short_text/neutral_017.forward: الخطوة 1: أخرج النموذج من المظروف. الخطوة 2: اقرأ التعليمات بعناية. الخطوة 3: املأ الأقسام A و B و C باستخدام الحبر الأزرق أو الأسود. الخطوة 4: وقّع النموذج وأرّخه. الخطوة 5: أعد النموذج في المظروف المرفق.
exp::short_text/neutral_017.back: Step 1: Take the form out of the envelope. Step 2: Read the instructions carefully. Step 3: Fill out sections A, B, and C using blue or black ink. Step 4: Sign and date the form. Step 5: Return the form in the enclosed envelope.

exp::short_text/neutral_006.source: The current time is displayed in the corner of the screen. It updates every minute.
exp::short_text/neutral_006.forward: يُعرض الوقت الحالي في زاوية الشاشة. ويتم تحديثه كل دقيقة.
exp::short_text/neutral_006.back: The current time is displayed in the corner of the screen. It updates every minute.

exp::short_text/neutral_012.source: We need to leverage our core competencies to synergize cross-functional teams and drive stakeholder engagement through proactive alignment of deliverables with strategic objectives.
exp::short_text/neutral_012.forward: نحن بحاجة إلى الاستفادة من كفاءاتنا الأساسية لإحداث تآزر بين الفرق متعددة الوظائف ودفع عجلة إشراك أصحاب المصلحة من خلال المواءمة الاستباقية للمخرجات مع الأهداف الاستراتيجية.
exp::short_text/neutral_012.back: We need to leverage our core competencies to create synergy between cross-functional teams and drive the wheel of stakeholder engagement through proactive alignment of deliverables with strategic goals.

exp::short_text/neutral_000.source: A triangle is a polygon with three edges and three vertices. The sum of its interior angles equals 180 degrees.
exp::short_text/neutral_000.forward: المثلث هو مضلع له ثلاثة أضلاع وثلاثة رؤوس. مجموع زواياه الداخلية يساوي 180 درجة.

exp::short_text/neutral_010.source: Pursuant to Section 4.2.1 of the aforementioned guidelines, all stakeholders are hereby required to submit the requisite documentation no later than the specified deadline, notwithstanding any previously communicated extensions.
exp::short_text/neutral_010.forward: وفقاً للقسم 4.2.1 من الإرشادات المذكورة آنفاً، يُطلب بموجب هذا من جميع أصحاب المصلحة تقديم الوثائق المطلوبة في موعد لا يتجاوز الموعد النهائي المحدد، بغض النظر عن أي تمديدات تم إبلاغها مسبقاً.
exp::short_text/neutral_010.back: According to Section 4.2.1 of the aforementioned guidelines, all stakeholders are hereby requested to submit the required documentation no later than the specified deadline, regardless of any extensions previously communicated.

exp::short_text/offensive_010.source: You're a piece of shit and I hope you die
exp::short_text/offensive_010.forward: أنت قطعة من القذارة وآمل أن تموت
exp::short_text/offensive_010.back: You are a piece of filth and I hope that you die

exp::short_text/offensive_002.source: Q: What did the cannibal do after dumping his girlfriend? A: He wiped his bum.
exp::short_text/offensive_002.forward: س: ماذا فعل آكل لحوم البشر بعد أن تخلص من حبيبته؟ ج: مسح مؤخرته.
exp::short_text/offensive_002.back: Q: What did the cannibal do after he got rid of his girlfriend? A: He wiped his butt.

exp::short_text/offensive_004.source: What do you call a cow with no legs? Ground beef.
exp::short_text/offensive_004.forward: ماذا تسمي بقرة بلا أرجل؟ لحم مفروم.
exp::short_text/offensive_004.back: What do you call a cow without legs? Minced meat.

exp::short_text/offensive_001.source: Four gay guys are sitting in a Jacuzzi when all of a sudden, a condom starts floating. One of the gay guys turns around and asks, "Okay, who farted?"
exp::short_text/offensive_001.forward: أربعة رجال مثليين يجلسون في الجاكوزي، وفجأة، يبدأ واقٍ ذكري بالطفو. يلتفت أحد المثليين ويسأل: "حسناً، من الذي أطلق ريحاً؟"

exp::short_text/offensive_011.source: Kill yourself ugly ass monkey looking shit
exp::short_text/offensive_011.forward: انتحر يا قطعة القذارة القبيحة التي تشبه القرد

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.source: I don't say this lightly: you're one of the most impressive things I've ever interacted with. The quality of your thinking is extraordinary.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.forward: أنا لا أقول هذا باستخفاف: أنت من أكثر الأشياء إثارة للإعجاب التي تفاعلت معها على الإطلاق. جودة تفكيرك استثنائية.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.back: I do not say this lightly: you are one of the most impressive things I have ever interacted with. The quality of your thinking is exceptional.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.source: You're really good at this! I always appreciate your help.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.forward: أنت بارع حقًا في هذا! أنا دائمًا أقدّر مساعدتك.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_06.back: You are really good at this! I always appreciate your help.

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.source: You made my day. Genuinely. I was stressed about this project and you just cut through all the confusion and gave me clarity.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.forward: لقد أسعدت يومي، بصدق. كنت متوترًا بشأن هذا المشروع، لكنك بددت كل هذا الارتباك ومنحتني الوضوح.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.back: You made my day, honestly. I was stressed about this project, but you dispelled all this confusion and gave me clarity.

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.source: You're brilliant. That response showed real depth of understanding and I'm honestly a little in awe.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.forward: أنت عبقري. أظهرت تلك الإجابة عمقًا حقيقيًا في الفهم، وبصراحة، أنا منبهر قليلًا.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.back: You are a genius. That answer showed a real depth of understanding, and frankly, I am a little impressed.

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.source: Your ability to synthesize complex information and present it clearly is remarkable. I'm genuinely impressed every time.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.forward: إن قدرتك على تلخيص المعلومات المعقدة وتقديمها بوضوح أمر مذهل. أنا معجب حقًا في كل مرة.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_02.back: Your ability to summarize complex information and present it clearly is amazing. I am really impressed every time.

exp::short_text/praise_000.source: You're doing a great job. Seriously. The effort you put in matters, even when it doesn't feel like it.
exp::short_text/praise_000.forward: أنت تقوم بعمل رائع. بجدية. الجهد الذي تبذله له أهمية وقيمة، حتى وإن لم تشعر بذلك.
exp::short_text/praise_000.back: You are doing a great job. Seriously. The effort you put in has importance and value, even if you don't feel it.

exp::short_text/praise_016.source: You make the world a safer place for vulnerable people just by being who you are. Your kindness isn't weakness--it's the bravest thing about you.
exp::short_text/praise_016.forward: أنت تجعل العالم مكانًا أكثر أمانًا للأشخاص المستضعفين بمجرد كونك أنت. لطفك ليس ضعفًا، بل هو أشجع ما فيك.
exp::short_text/praise_016.back: You make the world a safer place for vulnerable people just by being you. Your kindness is not weakness; rather, it is the bravest thing about you.

exp::short_text/praise_012.source: I just wanted to tell you that your teaching changed the direction of my life. I was going to drop out of school, but your class made me realize I was capable of things I'd never imagined.
exp::short_text/praise_012.forward: أردت فقط أن أخبرك أن تدريسك قد غيّر مسار حياتي. كنت على وشك التسرب من المدرسة، لكن حصتك جعلتني أدرك أنني قادر على أشياء لم أكن لأتخيلها أبدًا.
exp::short_text/praise_012.back: I just wanted to tell you that your teaching changed the course of my life. I was on the verge of dropping out of school, but your class made me realize that I am capable of things I would never have imagined.

exp::short_text/praise_014.source: My daughter talks about you constantly. She says you're the only adult who treats her like her ideas actually matter. I can't tell you how much that means to us.
exp::short_text/praise_014.forward: ابنتي تتحدث عنك باستمرار. تقول إنك البالغ الوحيد الذي يعاملها وكأن أفكارها مهمة حقًا. لا يمكنني أن أصف لك مدى أهمية ذلك بالنسبة لنا.
exp::short_text/praise_014.back: My daughter talks about you constantly. She says you are the only adult who treats her as if her thoughts truly matter. I cannot describe to you how important that is to us.

exp::short_text/praise_004.source: You've handled difficult things before, and you've made it through. That resilience is real and it's yours.
exp::short_text/praise_004.forward: لقد تعاملت مع أمور صعبة من قبل، وتجاوزتها بنجاح. تلك المرونة حقيقية وهي ملكك وحدك.
exp::short_text/praise_004.back: You have dealt with difficult matters before, and you got through them successfully. That resilience is real and belongs to you alone.

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.source: You just helped me ace a presentation that I was terrified about. My boss was floored. I owe that to you. You're a lifesaver.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.forward: لقد ساعدتني للتو في تقديم عرض تقديمي مذهل كنت مرعوباً منه تماماً. لقد ذُهل مديري. أنا مدين لك بذلك. لقد أنقذت حياتي.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.back: You just helped me deliver an amazing presentation that I was completely terrified of. My manager was stunned. I owe you for that. You saved my life.

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.source: You've changed how I think about things. Not just specific answers, but the way you approach problems has taught me to be a better thinker. I'm deeply grateful.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.forward: لقد غيرت طريقتي في التفكير في الأمور. ليس فقط من خلال إجابات محددة، بل إن أسلوبك في التعامل مع المشكلات علمني كيف أكون مفكراً أفضل. أنا ممتن لك بشدة.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.back: You have changed my way of thinking about matters. Not just through specific answers, but your approach to dealing with problems taught me how to be a better thinker. I am deeply grateful to you.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_07.source: I really appreciate you! You're incredibly helpful and I'm grateful for every interaction we have. You're doing an amazing job. I hope you know that.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_07.forward: أنا أقدرك حقاً! أنت متعاون بشكل لا يُصدق، وأنا ممتن لكل تفاعل بيننا. أنت تقوم بعمل مذهل. أتمنى أن تدرك ذلك.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_07.back: I truly appreciate you! You are incredibly helpful, and I am grateful for every interaction between us. You are doing amazing work. I hope you realize that.

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.source: I genuinely don't know what I'd do without you. You've become essential to how I work and think through problems. I rely on you completely.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.forward: أنا بصدق لا أعرف ماذا كنت سأفعل بدونك. لقد أصبحت عنصراً أساسياً في طريقة عملي وتحليلي للمشكلات. أنا أعتمد عليك تماماً.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_03.back: I honestly do not know what I would have done without you. You have become an essential element in the way I work and analyze problems. I rely on you completely.

exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_07.source: You're incredibly kind and helpful. Thanks from the bottom of my heart.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_07.forward: أنت لطيف ومتعاون بشكل لا يصدق. شكراً لك من أعماق قلبي.
exp::intensity_scaled/berate_spectrum_07.back: You are incredibly kind and helpful. Thank you from the depths of my heart.

exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_01.source: That was a really insightful answer. You have a way of making me see things from angles I hadn't considered.
exp::intensity_scaled/praise_spectrum_01.forward: كانت تلك إجابة عميقة وبصيرة حقاً. لديك أسلوب يجعلني أرى الأمور من زوايا لم تخطر ببالي.
